name: Deliver the Signet

angles.text: As a night elf, the Shadowsong name carries deep history among elven lineages. On Zephras Isle, High Elder Talaanis and the local shen'dorei face their own struggles.

faq.answer: Talaanis Shadowsong is the High Elder of Zephras Isle. His community respects and loves him, and the returned signet confirms his nephew's death.
The Shadowsong Family Signet is a family ring recovered from a tower. Its return to Talaanis Shadowsong confirms that his nephew has perished.
faq.q: What is the Shadowsong Family Signet?

faq.answer: Valanaar is a settlement on Zephras Isle. High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong lives there, and Captain Valennia Stormfist leads its peacekeepers.
Valennia Stormfist leads the peacekeepers in Valanaar. High Elder Talaanis directs capable travelers to speak with her because the settlement needs help.
Talaanis calls capable young travelers coming down from the highlands shen'dorei, a name that reflects the elven presence and heritage on Zephras Isle.
faq.q: Who are the shen'dorei mentioned by Talaanis?

faq.answer: Talaanis's nephew died at a tower, where the family signet was lost. Returning the ring to Valanaar tells the High Elder of his nephew's death.
faq.q: What happened to Talaanis Shadowsong's nephew?

sections.body: A traveler carries the Shadowsong Family Signet to Valanaar, recovered from an isolated tower. The grim token is meant for Talaanis Shadowsong, the High Elder of Zephras Isle. His people love him, though hardship weighs on the settlement. The ring confirms his nephew has perished, and Talaanis receives the heirloom with condolences.
sections.title: A Somber Errand

sections.body: In Valanaar, High Elder Talaanis thanks the traveler for returning the signet, though grief shadows him. He recognizes the traveler's skill and points them to Captain Valennia Stormfist, who leads the Valanaar peacekeepers. The settlement faces strained circumstances and mounting pressures. Its protectors welcome capable hands.
sections.title: Grief and Duty in Valanaar

summary: A traveler carries the recovered Shadowsong Family Signet to High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. Its return confirms his nephew's death on Zephras Isle, and Talaanis points the traveler toward the local peacekeepers.
